maxCompetitors: Up to {n} competitors; each is a separate request.
noCompetitorsText: Add competitors to the project or choose them above. You can add them with one click on the Competitors tab of the Domain overview.
missingHint: Keywords competitors rank for and you do not; shared by more competitors first
sharedHint: Keywords both you and competitors rank for; marked weak where a competitor ranks higher
linksHint: Sites linking to every chosen competitor but not to you; good link prospects
bulkPlaceholder: Type domains, one per line or separated by commas (empty: the project and its competitors)
bulkHint: Up to 100 domains; traffic and authority together
shareHint: How is market share worked out?
shareText: The estimated monthly organic traffic of the compared sites is added up; each site's share is its percentage of that total. Against competitors in the same market it shows the share of visibility.
